questions.stem: 讓自動駕駛車取代人類駕駛可以避免人為疏失，而人為疏失是多數車禍的元兇。
questions.answer: Letting self-driving cars take over from human drivers can prevent human error, which is responsible for the majority of traffic accidents.
accepted_answers: Replacing human drivers with self-driving cars can help avoid human error, which is the main cause of most car accidents.
Allowing self-driving cars to take the place of human drivers can prevent human errors, which are to blame for most traffic accidents.

questions.stem: 然而，已有數起致命車禍被歸咎於自駕車，使許多人懷疑這項技術是否真的可靠。
questions.answer: However, several deadly crashes have been blamed on self-driving cars, making many people question whether this technology is really reliable.
accepted_answers: However, a number of fatal accidents have been blamed on driverless cars, causing many people to doubt whether the technology is truly reliable.
However, self-driving cars have been blamed for several deadly crashes, leaving many people wondering if this technology can really be trusted.

1.explanation_zh: 句首「讓…取代…」是整個動作當主詞，英文用動名詞片語 Letting self-driving cars take over from human drivers（或 Replacing human drivers with self-driving cars），動詞視為單數。「而人為疏失是…」補充說明 human error，用非限定關係子句 , which is responsible for …（which 前加逗號、不用 that）。「元兇」是比喻，用 be responsible for／be the main cause of；「多數車禍」是 most car accidents（不加 the）或 the majority of traffic accidents。
evidence: 讓自動駕駛車取代人類駕駛
而人為疏失是多數車禍的元兇
1.strategy_zh: 中文主詞是一串動作時，英文改成 V-ing 開頭；後半句重複前面的名詞時，改用 , which … 接上。
hints: 切成四段：讓自動駕駛車取代人類駕駛／可以避免人為疏失／而人為疏失是…的元兇／多數車禍
標的詞彙：self-driving（自動駕駛的）、replace（取代）、human（人類的）、prevent（避免）、error（疏失）、accident（事故）
句型框架：V-ing … + can + V + N, which is responsible for …

2.explanation_zh: 「已有…被歸咎於」是到目前為止累積的事件，用完成式被動 have been blamed on（blame A on B ＝ blame B for A）。「使許多人懷疑…」是前一件事造成的結果，用句尾分詞 making many people question whether …／causing many people to doubt whether …（make 接原形動詞、cause 接 to V）。「懷疑是否」用 doubt／question／wonder whether，不是 suspect；whether 子句用直述句語序。
evidence: 已有數起致命車禍被歸咎於自駕車
使許多人懷疑這項技術是否真的可靠
2.strategy_zh: 「被歸咎於」先想 blame A on B；「使…懷疑是否…」用 making sb question whether + 直述句。
hints: 切成四段：已有數起致命車禍／被歸咎於自駕車／使許多人懷疑／這項技術是否真的可靠
標的詞彙：deadly（致命的）、crash（車禍）、blame（歸咎）、doubt（懷疑）、technology（技術）、reliable（可靠的）
句型框架：However, S + have been p.p. + on …, making + O + V + whether + S + V

references: Letting self-driving cars take over from human drivers can prevent human error, which is responsible for the majority of traffic accidents.
Replacing human drivers with self-driving cars can help avoid human error, which is the main cause of most car accidents.
Allowing self-driving cars to take the place of human drivers can prevent human errors, which are to blame for most traffic accidents.

patterns.label_zh: 非限定關係子句（補充說明前面的名詞）
patterns.frame: S + V + N, which + is responsible for …

patterns.zh_trigger: 讓自動駕駛車取代人類駕駛

parts.zh: 讓自動駕駛車取代人類駕駛
accepted: Letting self-driving cars take over from human drivers
Replacing human drivers with self-driving cars
Allowing self-driving cars to take the place of human drivers
Allowing self-driving cars to replace human drivers
Letting self-driving cars replace human drivers

common_errors.wrong: Let self-driving cars replace human drivers can
common_errors.right: Letting self-driving cars replace human drivers can
common_errors.explanation_zh: 原形動詞片語不能當主詞，要改成動名詞 Letting …（或 To let …）。

common_errors.wrong: Replacing self-driving cars with human drivers
common_errors.right: Replacing human drivers with self-driving cars
common_errors.explanation_zh: replace A with B 是「用 B 取代 A」，A、B 不要放反。
man-made 指「人造的（東西）」，「人為疏失」是 human error。

common_errors.wrong: can prevent human from making error
common_errors.right: can prevent humans from making errors
common_errors.explanation_zh: prevent sb from V-ing 的 sb 要用複數 humans／people，error 可數時也要用複數。

accepted: which is the main cause of
which is the leading cause of

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「是…的元兇」用 be responsible for（造成、要負責），介系詞是 for。

common_errors.wrong: human error, that is the main cause of
common_errors.right: human error, which is the main cause of
common_errors.explanation_zh: 非限定關係子句不能用 that。
「多數的」是 most（不加 the）；the most 是最高級「最多」。
the majority of 後面接複數名詞。

traps.zh: 讓自動駕駛車取代人類駕駛
traps.literal_error: Let self-driving cars replace human drivers can prevent human error …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文以整個動作當主詞；英文原形動詞不能當主詞，要用動名詞 Letting …／Replacing …（或 To let …）。

traps.literal_error: … which is the chief criminal of most car accidents.
traps.explanation_zh: 「元兇」是比喻，不要譯成 criminal／murderer；用 be responsible for／be the main cause of／be to blame for。

bonus.text: Were self-driving cars to take over from human drivers, human error, which is responsible for the majority of traffic accidents, could be avoided.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用省略 if 的倒裝假設 Were + S + to V …（假如真的讓…）；屬於假設語氣的加分寫法，不設為唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 中文主詞「讓自動駕駛車取代人類駕駛」是一個動作，英文改成動名詞主詞 Letting …／Replacing …；後半「而人為疏失是…」不重複主詞，用 , which is responsible for … 接在 human error 後面。

references: However, several deadly crashes have been blamed on self-driving cars, making many people question whether this technology is really reliable.
However, a number of fatal accidents have been blamed on driverless cars, causing many people to doubt whether the technology is truly reliable.
However, self-driving cars have been blamed for several deadly crashes, leaving many people wondering if this technology can really be trusted.

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（…，使…）
patterns.frame: S + V …, making + O + V ／ causing + O + to V

patterns.zh_trigger: 已有數起致命車禍被歸咎於

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「致命的」是 deadly／fatal；dead 是「死的」，不能修飾車禍。

accepted: have been blamed on self-driving cars
have been blamed on driverless cars
self-driving cars have been blamed for
have been blamed on autonomous cars
have been attributed to self-driving cars

common_errors.wrong: have been blamed to self-driving cars
common_errors.right: have been blamed on self-driving cars
common_errors.explanation_zh: blame A on B（把 A 歸咎於 B）或 blame B for A；介系詞是 on／for，不是 to。

common_errors.right: have been blamed on self-driving cars
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「已有」表示到目前為止累積的事件，用現在完成式被動 have been blamed。

accepted: causing many people to doubt whether

common_errors.explanation_zh: suspect 是「懷疑（某事可能是真的）」，後面接 that 子句；「懷疑是否…」用 doubt／question／wonder whether。
逗號後表結果用分詞 making；makes 會變成兩個動詞沒有連接詞。

parts.zh: 這項技術是否真的可靠
accepted: this technology can really be trusted

common_errors.explanation_zh: whether 引導的名詞子句用直述句語序，不要倒裝成問句。
「這項技術」指自駕車的科技，用 technology；technique 是「技巧、手法」。

traps.literal_error: … making many people suspect whether this technology is really reliable.
traps.explanation_zh: 「懷疑是否」是 doubt／question／wonder whether；suspect 是「懷疑某事可能是真的」（suspect that …），意思相反。

traps.literal_error: However, several deadly crashes were blamed on self-driving cars …
traps.explanation_zh: 「已有」是到目前為止累積的事件，用現在完成式被動 have been blamed on。

bonus.text: However, several deadly crashes have been blamed on self-driving cars, casting doubt on whether this technology is really reliable.
bonus.explanation_zh: cast doubt on …（使人對…產生懷疑）是很道地的句尾分詞搭配。

2.restructuring_zh: 中文「已有數起致命車禍被歸咎於自駕車」可照原順序寫成 Several deadly crashes have been blamed on …，也可以把自駕車當主詞 Self-driving cars have been blamed for …；「使許多人懷疑…」用句尾分詞 making many people question whether … 接在後面。

1.translation: Letting self-driving cars replace human drivers can help avoid human error, which is the main culprit behind most car accidents.
1.explanation_zh: 「讓自動駕駛車取代人類駕駛」用動名詞片語 Letting ... replace 當主詞（也可寫 Replacing human drivers with self-driving cars）；「而人為疏失是…元兇」用非限定關係子句 which 修飾 human error；「元兇」譯為 the main culprit behind（也可用 the main cause of）。

2.translation: However, several fatal accidents have been blamed on self-driving cars, leading many people to question whether this technology is really reliable.
2.explanation_zh: 「已有數起…被歸咎於」用現在完成式被動 have been blamed on；「使許多人懷疑…是否」用分詞構句 leading many people to question whether（也可用 making many people doubt whether）。

issues_zh: （建議補 accepted）我用 which is the main culprit behind 譯「是…的元兇」，語意和第 3 部分 accepted（which is the main cause of、which is responsible for 等）相同，但不在清單裡，建議補上 which is the main culprit behind。R1 的 the main cause of most car accidents 中 main 與 most 語意略重複，可接受。
（建議補 accepted）我用分詞構句 leading many people to question whether，結構和 causing many people to doubt whether 相同，但不在第 3 部分 accepted，建議補上。句首「然而」沒有分到任何部分。

1.translation: Letting self-driving cars replace human drivers can avoid human error, which is the main cause of most car accidents.
1.explanation_zh: 主詞「讓自動駕駛車取代人類駕駛」用動名詞片語 Letting ... replace ...；「而人為疏失是……元兇」用 which 引導補充說明。中文主詞也可用 Replacing human drivers with self-driving cars 表達，措辭有彈性所以信心中等。

2.translation: However, several fatal accidents have been blamed on self-driving cars, making many people doubt whether this technology is truly reliable.
2.explanation_zh: 「已有數起……被歸咎於」用現在完成式被動 have been blamed on；「使許多人懷疑」用分詞片語 making ... doubt whether ...。
